summary: Tested Customer Retrieval Feature for ParKaro platform. All 12 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified: public retrieve page shows vehicle info, valet fee, 'Get My Car' button works, pending_payment and 'Request In Progress' states display correctly. OTP login works for admin and valet. Super admin email/password login works. WhatsApp messaging confirmed working via backend logs.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id} returns vehicle info (license_plate, client_name, valet_fee, active_ticket_status) without auth
Backend: GET /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id} returns 404 for invalid vehicle_id
Backend: POST /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id}/confirm creates open ticket when valet_fee=0
Backend: POST /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id}/confirm creates pending_payment ticket when valet_fee>1
Backend: POST /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id}/confirm returns 400 for duplicate retrieval request
Backend: POST /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id}/confirm returns 404 for invalid vehicle_id
Backend: POST /api/whatsapp/webhook returns TwiML XML with Content-Type application/xml
Backend: POST /api/whatsapp/webhook handles RETR command
Backend: Admin OTP login works (+919373991136)
Backend: Valet OTP login works (+919922668866)
Backend: Super admin email/password login works (superadmin@swiftvalet.com)
Backend: Vehicle parking sends WhatsApp message with retrieve URL (confirmed in logs)
Frontend: /retrieve/:vehicleId page loads and shows PARKARO branding, client name
Frontend: /retrieve/:vehicleId shows license plate and tag number
Frontend: /retrieve/:vehicleId shows valet fee when set (Rs.200)
Frontend: /retrieve/:vehicleId 'Get My Car' button works and creates ticket
Frontend: /retrieve/:vehicleId shows 'Request Confirmed!' for open ticket
Frontend: /retrieve/:vehicleId shows 'Payment Required' for pending_payment ticket
Frontend: /retrieve/:vehicleId shows 'Request In Progress' for already-retrieved vehicle
Frontend: /retrieve/:vehicleId shows 'Already Collected' for checked_out vehicle
Frontend: Admin dashboard loads correctly after OTP login
Frontend: Valet dashboard loads correctly after OTP login
Frontend: Super admin dashboard loads correctly after email/password login

context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Retrieval Feature is fully working. Key features: 1) Public page at /retrieve/:vehicleId shows vehicle info without auth. 2) GET /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id} returns license_plate, client_name, valet_fee, active_ticket_status. 3) POST /api/retrieve/{vehicle_id}/confirm creates ticket (open if no fee, pending_payment if fee>1). 4) Frontend shows different states: confirm page, 'Request Confirmed!', 'Payment Required', 'Request In Progress', 'Already Collected'. 5) WhatsApp messaging mode is active (MESSAGING_MODE=whatsapp in backend/.env). 6) Webhook returns TwiML XML responses. 7) All login methods working: OTP for admin/valet, email/password for super admin. Valet fee was reset to 0 after testing.
